name: Article
purpose: A long read: text at a reading measure, a margin beside it for figures and asides, and a table of contents that stays in view where there is room.
notFor: Application screens with lists, tables or boards - that is AppShell with the data components
Short text in a card or panel - a Card, or plain text
Styling the text itself - headings, lists and tables in the body are the product's

title.note: The article's h1, and the name of the article landmark.

eyebrow.content: Breadcrumbs, or the article's place in a sequence

meta.note: Position in a sequence, reading time.

toc.note: Headings in the body as { id, label }. Wide: a sticky list in the third column. Otherwise: a disclosure under the header.

tocLabel.note: Names the table of contents landmark.

children.content: The body, with ArticleMargin placed before the paragraph it belongs to

footer.content: A completion control, the next article

keyboard.Enter: On a table of contents entry, moves to that heading. Native link.

aria.role: article (implicit, from <article>), named by the title

attributes.aria-current: location, on the table of contents entry for the section in view

aria.labelling: The title names the article; tocLabel names the table of contents navigation.
aria.focus: Links in the table of contents move focus to the heading through the browser's fragment navigation. The component moves no focus itself.
